title: cvpw qa/report.json
description: The gate suite's result. Derived, carries a run record, and is never an input to a stage. Check ids and thresholds are defined once in docs/QA.md; this file records what was observed against them.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601. Permitted here and only in the three report artifacts (docs/SPEC.md A6).

only.description: Block id, when the run was restricted to one block's range.

id.description: A check id from docs/QA.md. An id that does not exist there is a bug: thresholds are defined once.

status.description: `skipped` requires a reason and is never a pass. A project that has skipped its way to a green report has not been verified.

threshold.description: The threshold AS READ from its declared source, so a report can be audited without opening docs/QA.md.

offenders.description: Concrete instances that justify the verdict: times, shot ids, asset paths. A failure with no offenders is not actionable.

waivedBy.description: The exemption key in qa/exemptions.json, when waived.

ok.description: True only when no check failed. A skipped check does not make this false, which is why `status` exists.

waived.description: Every waiver used in this run, copied here so the delivery report can state them without opening another file.
